booking.cancelBody: {service}, {date}. The time becomes free for someone else, and we'll email you a confirmation.
booking.cancelError: The booking couldn't be cancelled. Try again, or write to us.
booking.tooLate: Free cancellation ends 24 hours before the start. To change it now, call or write to us.

nextBooking.title: Next booking
nextBooking.emptyBody: Book a lab test or a session and you'll see when, where and how to prepare right here.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.complete: Everything's there. We know how to reach you.
profile.name: your name
Name
profile.emailHint: You sign in with this address. To change it, write to us.
profile.phoneHint: So we can reach you about a booking.
profile.languageHint: The language of this site and of our emails to you.
profile.error: Saving didn't work. Check the fields and try again.
profile.invalidPhone: Enter a phone number of at least 6 characters, or leave it empty.

consents.title: Consents
consents.lead: What you've agreed to, and when. You can change it at any time.
consents.health_data: Processing of my health and training data
consents.error: Saving the change didn't work. Try again.
consents.healthTitle: Withdraw consent for your health data?
consents.healthIntro: Without it we may not process your health and training data. This stops working:
consents.healthStop1: Your account (overview, bookings, profile) asks for this consent again before it opens.
consents.healthStop2: We can't record your lab results or prepare a training plan for you.
consents.healthStop3: Coaches no longer see your health answers in your account.
consents.healthKeeps: Your bookings stay as they are, and you can still manage them from the link in your emails. Data we already hold stays until you delete your account.

export.title: Download your data
export.body: A zip file with everything we hold about you: profile, consents and bookings, as JSON and as CSV for spreadsheets.

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.body: We delete your profile, consents, health answers and sign-in details. For accounting we must keep a record of past bookings for 10 years, without your name, email or phone.
delete.sent: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it within an hour to delete your account.
delete.error: The email couldn't be sent. Try again later.
delete.upcoming: You have upcoming bookings. Cancel them first, or write to us.
delete.staff: A coach account can't be deleted here. Ask the owner.

confirm.title: Delete your account
confirm.body: This can't be undone. Your profile, consents, health answers and sign-in details are deleted right away. Past bookings stay in our accounting records for 10 years, without your name, email or phone.
confirm.invalid: This link has expired or belongs to another account. Ask for a new one on the privacy page.
confirm.error: Deleting didn't work. Try again, or write to us.
confirm.missing: Open this page from the link in the email.
confirm.doneBody: Thank you for training with us. If you sign in again with the same email, you start with a new, empty account.
